blocks.alt: The steps involved in the process of epidemiologic inference are as follows: Observation leads to a cyclic process that involves the following four steps: make comparisons, generate, hypotheses, and test. The cyclic process further gives rise to descriptive epidemiology, analytic epidemiology, and epidemiologic inference. Descriptive epidemiology involves questions such as who, what, where, when, & how many? It rules out chance, bias, and confounding and involves design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation. Analytic epidemiology involves questions such as why & how? It controls for chance, bias, and confounding and involves design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation.
